title: Associate Software Engineer
bullets: Architected a 199-endpoint REST API (Laravel 12 / PHP 8.2 / PostgreSQL) with four authentication layers — Laravel Sanctum (admin/franchisee), PIN-based driver auth, Microsoft Azure AD SSO, and 6-scope API-key auth for IoT cabinet hardware — via a custom 10-middleware chain with rate limiting, audit logging, and security headers.

Designed a 39-table schema (69 versioned migrations); optimised battery-telemetry queries with SQL window functions (ROW_NUMBER OVER PARTITION BY) to fetch latest BMS metrics across a 9-table battery-history schema in a single pass, eliminating N+1 patterns.

Built a production geofence engine backed by Tile38 (Redis geospatial DB) with a GeoJSON fallback — GPS jitter filtering, active-hours scheduling, cooldown suppression, dwell-time tracking — violations broadcast in real time via Laravel Reverb WebSockets.
Integrated bKash payment webhooks (AWS SNS) with idempotent reconciliation — transaction/message-ID deduplication, malformed-JSON repair, SNS signature verification, automatic wallet crediting.

Delivered two React frontends: a 21-page admin dashboard (Next.js 15 / React 19) with a Leaflet geofence editor and Recharts/Chart.js analytics, plus a 6-page offline-first field PWA — both role-scoped via Spatie RBAC.
Built a Python automation pipeline (pandas/openpyxl) generating daily machine- and driver-wise Excel reports delivered via Microsoft Graph API as a production cron job.
